title: IW1--IW7: actual integral Weyl/Fock comparison and shared projector denominator
status: Human mathematical reconstruction with exact pinned source records; no Lean build, whole-proof verification, or signed path-basis reconstruction claimed.

claims.result: p^D I_h preserves any root-divided-power-stable O-module, D=binom(k,2)floor(log_p(h+k-1)).
claims.status: Proved by explicit multinomial expansion and Legendre's formula; direct general DVR proof.

claims.result: I_h takes weight zero to invariants, is natural, and preserves trace on End(U).
claims.status: Proved by commutator recurrence, telescoping, weight cutoff, and finite gl2 strings. No unexpanded projector formula.

claims.result: For the actual square polynomial lattice, p^D nabla subset Delta subset nabla, with exponent zero at zero spread.
claims.status: Proved from IW1/IW2 applied to highest projection in Hom(nabla,Delta), using explicitly stated classical characteristic-zero GL background.

claims.result: Any isotypic projector e preserves a graded divided-power-stable lattice after multiplying by p^D.
claims.status: Proved by exact rank-one Hom averaging formula. h bounds same-coordinate differences of TWO V weights, not within-weight spread. BB specialization and projector commutation in companion.
New elementary square-model proof: Gaussian recovery and primitive polynomial content replace the source integral standard-monomial/coefficient-word route.

claims.result: Actual normalized tensor form gives p^kappa L(A^-t) subset Psi(L(A)^*) subset L(A^-t), including correctly scaled opposite edge lattices.
claims.status: Proved by inverse-transpose adjointness, determinant cancellation, tensor dual bases and w^2=p midpoint identity. Exact be pairing factor p^Ar retained.

claims.result: h_s+k<=a^2 implies source two-family kappa<=4Nk^2 log_p a.
claims.status: Elementary bound proves the sharper 2Nk(k-1)log_p a; assembled source constant 4 is retained.

classical_field_background: Finite-dimensional rational representations of split GL_k in characteristic zero are completely reducible.
Every nonzero irreducible has a highest vector; PBW generation implies weight dominance.
The relevant modules are split; a commuting endomorphism is scalar on its highest line and hence on the cyclic irreducible.

main_formulae.omega: Omega_0=1; Omega_(q+1)=sum_(i in S)E_zi Omega_q E_iz
main_formulae.denominator: D=binom(k,2)floor(log_p(h+k-1)); zero at k=1 or normalized spread h=0
main_formulae.projector: e_U(y)=dim(U)*sum_i A(u_i^* tensor y)(u_i), A=I_h after weight-zero projection
main_formulae.normalization: B(P,Q)=sum_alpha P_alpha Q_alpha alpha! / sum_alpha H_alpha^2 alpha!
main_formulae.duality: Delta^#=nabla, nabla^#=Delta, p^D nabla subset nabla^# subset nabla
main_formulae.basis_convention: L_lambda(A)=det(A)^(-lambda_k)*R(A inverse)*nabla; equivalent membership det(A)^(lambda_k)*R(A)F in nabla

remaining_separate_inputs: Integral Cartan multiplication and complementary semistandard family outside the square Fock comparison.
Signed path-column integral basis and geometric realization of tests.
Arithmetic and cohomological window inputs for RH/Dirichlet GRH.
